# Ahlan Wasahlan

> A Moroccan and Uzbek food recipe blog and online shop featuring authentic traditional recipes and culinary ingredients.

Ahlan Wasahlan specializes in North African and Central Asian cuisine, with a focus on Moroccan and Uzbek recipes, traditional cooking techniques, and authentic ingredients like chermoula marinades, preserved lemons, and harissa pastes.

## Key Topics

- Moroccan cuisine
- Uzbek cuisine
- Moroccan Carrot Salad
- Chermoula marinade
- Khizou Mchermel
- Zaalouk
- Harissa paste
- Preserved lemon
- North African cuisine
- Vegetarian recipes
- Side dishes
- Make-ahead recipes

## Moroccan Recipes

- [Moroccan Carrot Salad](https://www.ahlanwasahlan.co.uk/moroccan-carrot-salad): Recipe for Moroccan carrot salad with chermoula marinade and khizou mchermel
